plugins.name: Qoder
plugins.description: Qoder provider for CPA: CN (qoder.com.cn) and Intl (qoder.com / openapi.qoder.sh) in one plugin. Per-account region routing, device-flow + PAT login, COSY-signed streaming chat with tool calling, panel-managed model catalog (hide/restore/order/add), CN daily check-in and Intl campaign check-in, per-model cooldown, credit lifecycle and token keepalive.
plugins.author: bfSan (qoderwork originally by Sliverkiss, based on qoderwork by lovingfish)
plugins.changelog: Panel refresh no longer erases a model catalog capability data: it preserves the stored multipliers, context tiers and thinking tiers instead of overwriting them with nil.
